item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hi, I’m Danison Ng. I’m a Junior SWE who enjoys building full-stack apps, statistical analysis, and working on creative projects that merge technology and design.

This blog is where I share my work and ideas — from APIs I’m building to thoughts and quotes that inspire me.

Check out my posts or connect with me via GitHub or LinkedIn.
